theme_strategy: Light theme focused on ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY. Calming, growth-oriented feel suitable for a habit building and community discussion platform.

typography.headings: Manrope (font-sans). Do not use Inter for headings. Use tracking-tight for H1/H2 to provide tension and character.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans or standard clean sans. Must be highly legible for comment threads and textareas.

layouts.global: Sidebar layout on desktop (256px width), top nav + hamburger menu on mobile. Main content area must have generous padding (p-8 or p-12) to prevent a cramped feeling.
layouts.header: Sticky header for mobile with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 and 1px bottom border (border-[#E5E7E2]). Never fully transparent if content scrolls beneath.
layouts.sidebar: Solid surface background (#FFFFFF) with a right border. Contains links to 'My habits', 'Community', and a 'Sign out' button at the bottom.
layouts.habit_list: High-density Bento grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6).
layouts.habit_detail: Bento-style layout. Header spanning full width, 7-day checkboxes inside a dedicated 'Tactile' neumorphic or subtly bordered card to signify interactivity.
layouts.community_feed: Single column feed layout (max-w-2xl mx-auto) to optimize reading comments and discussions. Generous vertical spacing between shared habits.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Tactile' Variant: Flat solid backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-black/5) and very soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm). Do not overuse heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: Generous rounded corners: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons.

motion.hover: Interactive cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with a shadow increase. Buttons darken and scale down slightly (scale-95) on press.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle opacity and translate-y fade in for main content areas.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for habit list items.

components.button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), solid colors. Primary CTA in Sage Green (#4A6B56).
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized with soft focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4A6B56]/30).
components.checkboxes: Large, tactile checkboxes for the 7-day tracker. Check color: Sage Green. Essential for satisfaction when completing a habit.
components.cards: Flat, rectangular, 1px border. Padding must be generous (p-6 or p-8).
components.navigation: Active states in sidebar should have a soft background (bg-[#F0F2ED]) and bold text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text colors meet APCA/WCAG standards against backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sign-in-button', data-testid='habit-item-123', data-testid='comment-input').

media.images: No external images required per 'keep it simple' constraint. Rely purely on typography, spacing, and UI components.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using .js files (not .tsx) and Tailwind CSS.
Strictly adhere to the Earthy/Organic color palette.
Implement the Layout with a Sidebar containing 'My habits', 'Community', and 'Sign out' buttons.
Create the 'My habits' page featuring an add form (Habit name, When I do it, Share checkbox) and a list of habits showing their Shared/Private status.
Create the 'Habit detail' page with the 7-day trailing checklist (labeled with dates YYYY-MM-DD), 'Days done', and 'Current streak'.
Create the 'Community' page displaying shared habits and a commenting system.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, inputs, buttons, and checkboxes, heavily customizing them to remove default styles.
Do NOT add any unrequested features (like avatars, complex user profiles, external integrations).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Do not apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align for better readability.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-2xl button styles.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Create new .js components when needed.
